content.title: Two pets lost in Friday night fire in Iowa City
content.text: Skip to contentIOWA CITY, Iowa (KCRG) - Emergency crews were called to a fire in Iowa City Friday night, while reportedly nobody was hurt, two pets were lost.The Iowa City Fire Department was called around 11:10 p.m. to a condo on the city’s east side. The caller told first responders there was a fire in the basement, the blaze was brought under control in about 15 minutes after firefighters arrived.The fire damaged two units, leaving four people displaced. Damages are expected to be around $80,000 but the fire remains under investigation.Copyright 2026 KCRG.
